name: Orange Soda II
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Remove the zest from the oranges in strips, leaving behind the bitter white pith.
Combine the sugar and orange zest in a container, and let this sit in the fridge for 24 hours. The sugar will extract the liquid from the citrus peels and produce a syrupy liquid.
Stir the orange juice into the sugar mixture until everything is dissolved. Strain out the solids to yield slightly under ½ cup (120 ml) syrup.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of syrup with 3 volumes of carbonated water.
